hero_lede: Every day, everyone gets the same five colours. You see each one for a moment, then recreate it from memory. The closer you get, the more the circle looks like one colour.
step_1_text: A colour fills the screen. You get 5 seconds in the first round, then 4, 3, 2 and finally 1.
step_2_text: Recreate it with one thumb by picking hue, saturation and brightness. No numbers, no hex codes.
step_3_text: The circle splits: the colour you saw on the left, your choice on the right. Each round scores up to 100 points.
step_4_text: Up to 500 points a day. Share your result as one image with only numbers and colours.
share_text: Your puzzle number, your total and five split circles. It reads the same in every language, and the closer each circle looks to one colour, the better you remembered it.
share_card_label: Example share card: puzzle 3, 347 out of 500 points, five split circles
benefit_1_text: The whole world plays the same five colours each day, so every score can be compared.
benefit_2_text: Buttons and backgrounds stay grey, so nothing next to the colour changes how you see it.
benefit_3_text: Once a day, about two minutes. No ads, nothing interrupting your game, and no red when you miss.
home_description: A daily colour memory game. See five colours, then recreate them from memory.
